svg.metadata: TODO placeholder figure for Grokking Bitcoin Ch12 (Taproot). Replace with real Inkscape artwork.

text.tspan: Speedy Trial state machine. Like Figure 11-22 (BIP9 state machine) but
with: (a) shorter signaling window - 3 months instead of 1 year, (b) 90%
threshold instead of 95%, (c) mandatory delayed activation at a fixed
pre-announced block height after lock-in, (d) FAILED state if no lock-in
inside the window. Style match figure 11-22.
